title: Projection and exceptional adjunction give common dual left adjoints
statement: Let C,D be categories with H_C:C^op × C → C and H_D:D^op × D → D, and closed tensor-Hom structures S_C,S_D [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Assume S_C symmetric. Given p:C → D, q:D → C, s:C → D, an adjunction q ⊣ s, and a natural isomorphism q(N) tensor_C K ≅ q(N tensor_D p(K)), put D_M(K)=H_C(K,M). For every M in C the functor F=q ⋙ D_M.rightOp is left adjoint both to D_M ⋙ s and to p.op ⋙ H_D(-,s(M)).

source.place: The displayed Hom chain, with all arrows induced by adjunction and evaluation; last sentence on naturality.

proof.text: The contravariant self-adjunction gives D_M.rightOp ⊣ D_M. Compose it with q ⊣ s to get F ⊣ D_M ⋙ s.

For N in D and K in C^op use the first self-adjunction, inverse ambient currying, precomposition with the inverse projection isomorphism, the exceptional Hom equivalence, and closed-side currying. This constructs Hom(F(N),K) ≃ Hom(N,H_D(p(K),s(M))).

Verify naturality in N using projection naturality in the first variable and both adjunction naturality laws. Verify naturality in K using inverse transposition naturality, projection naturality in the second variable and closed-side transposition naturality. Package as Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. These are the two explicit naturality calculations in the Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem common_left_of_projection
    {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] {HD : Dᵒᵖ × D ⥤ D}
    (SD : CoefficientClosedStructure HD) (β : @SymmetricCategory C _ S.monoidal)
    (p : C ⥤ D) (q : D ⥤ C) (s : C ⥤ D) (a : q ⊣ s)
    (e : q.prod (𝟭 C) ⋙ S.tensor ≅ (𝟭 D).prod p ⋙ SD.tensor ⋙ q) (M : C) :
    ∃ F : D ⥤ Cᵒᵖ,
      Nonempty (Adjunction F (dual H M ⋙ s) ×
        Adjunction F (p.op ⋙ dual HD (s.obj M)))
